title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Yitong Chen, Shiduo Zhang, Jingjing Gong, Xipeng Qiu

tldr.en: Bias standard flow-matching training toward the noise endpoint to obtain one-step policies without distillation.
tldr.zh: 将标准 Flow Matching 的训练时间采样向噪声端偏移，获得无需蒸馏的一步策略。

evaluation_scope.en: LIBERO variants, multiple VLA architectures and real robots; model-forward profiling on RTX 5090 excludes I/O and networking. Results depend on training recipe and replanning.
evaluation_scope.zh: LIBERO 系列、多种 VLA 架构与真机；RTX 5090 的模型前向计时不含 I/O 和网络。结果依赖训练配置与重规划设置。
